📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

In a recent development, wall Street is entering the final weeks of 2026 with investors already assessing where the next phase of the U.S. stock market rally could emerge. Artificial intelligence remains central to corporate earnings, but rising infrastructure expenditure, valuation concerns and changing interest-rate expectations are creating opportunities across other industries. Bloomberg consensus estimates project S&P 500 earnings growth of 20.2% in 2027, with significant differences between sectors.

Technology leads the forecast, while healthcare, communication services and industrials offer additional growth opportunities. This report examines the earnings data, investment catalysts and publicly traded companies that could shape Wall Street’s sector leadership in 2027.

Industry observers note that the S&P 500 is expected to maintain positive earnings momentum in 2027, although growth could moderate from this year’s elevated levels. Bloomberg consensus estimates published November 17 project index earnings to increase 20.2% next year, compared with 29.9% in 2026. Revenue growth is expected to slow from 13.8% to 9.1%.

Sources indicate that the forecasts suggest that profitability will remain an vital market driver, but the distribution of earnings growth could change. Information Technology, Healthcare, Communication Services, Industrials and Consumer Discretionary are all projected to deliver double-digit earnings expansion.

Sources indicate that the moderation in revenue growth makes operating margins particularly important. Companies will need to convert sales expansion into earnings through productivity improvements, pricing power and cost discipline. A market rally supported by actual profit growth would also be more sustainable than one driven primarily by expanding valuation multiples.

Goldman Sachs expects the S&P 500 to deliver an 18% total return through the end of 2027, while forecasting 11% earnings growth. Its more conservative earnings projection highlights the uncertainty surrounding corporate profitability and AI investment returns.

In a recent development, information Technology remains the strongest projected earnings-growth sector heading into 2027. Bloomberg consensus estimates indicate that sector earnings could increase 41%, following estimated growth of 64.6% in 2026. Revenue is projected to expand 29.7%, significantly above the S&P 500’s expected 9.1%.

It has been revealed that the numbers indicate that AI-related demand could remain a significant source of corporate growth, even as the pace of expansion moderates. Semiconductor manufacturers, networking suppliers and cloud infrastructure providers are positioned to benefit from continued investment in computing capacity.

It has been revealed that nvidia remains central to AI accelerator demand, while Broadcom and AMD provide exposure to custom silicon, networking and data-center processors. Microsoft, Alphabet and Oracle offer additional exposure through cloud infrastructure and enterprise AI services.

Recent findings suggest that however, the investment cycle is becoming more demanding. Hyperscalers are committing substantial capital to data centers, while investors increasingly want evidence that AI revenue can justify those investments. Higher depreciation, financing costs and competition could affect future margins.

Recent findings suggest that healthcare presents one of the most notable changes in the 2027 earnings outlook. Bloomberg consensus estimates project sector earnings growth of 19.6%, compared with only 2.9% in 2026. Revenue growth, however, is forecast at 4%, suggesting that improved profitability could contribute more to earnings expansion than sales growth alone.

In a recent development, pharmaceutical innovation, obesity treatments, oncology drugs and medical technology remain important investment themes. Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk have established significant positions in the obesity-treatment market, while AbbVie and Merck offer exposure to specialty pharmaceuticals and oncology.

Industry observers note that the sector’s earnings recovery could also attract investors looking to diversify away from expensive technology stocks. Nevertheless, the difference between projected earnings and revenue growth requires attention. Margin improvement, product mix and cost management will determine whether the forecast translates into stronger reported results.

Recent findings suggest that communication Services is projected to deliver 19.3% earnings growth in 2027, compared with 10.8% in 2026. Unlike several other sectors, its revenue-growth outlook is also improving, with estimates rising from 12.6% to 14.6%.

Digital advertising is a major driver of this outlook. Meta and Alphabet operate large advertising ecosystems, where AI-powered recommendations, improved targeting and automated marketing tools could increase monetization.

It has been revealed that netflix provides another growth avenue through subscriptions, advertising and international expansion. However, competition for advertising budgets, regulatory scrutiny and rising content expenditure could affect operating performance.

Sources indicate that industrials could become an vital beneficiary of the AI investment cycle as spending moves beyond semiconductor manufacturing into physical infrastructure. Data centers require electrical systems, cooling equipment, power generation, construction services and transmission networks. Bloomberg consensus estimates project industrial earnings growth of 15.4% in 2027, with revenue expected to increase 9%.

Sources indicate that the sector’s investment case extends beyond data centers. Grid modernization, manufacturing expansion and defense procurement could support industrial demand. Companies supplying electrical equipment and infrastructure services may benefit from projects that require long-term investment and specialized engineering.

In a recent development, GE Vernova and Eaton provide exposure to power generation and electrical distribution, while Vertiv is positioned in data-center cooling and power management. Quanta Services offers exposure to electricity transmission and grid construction.

Financials have a more moderate earnings outlook for 2027, with projected growth of 6.4%, compared with 15.2% in 2026. Revenue growth is expected to decline from 9.5% to 5.1%.

Sources indicate that the sector’s opportunity lies in capital markets, lending, wealth management and trading activity. A stronger mergers-and-acquisitions environment could support investment banks, while stable credit conditions may benefit commercial lenders.

Industry observers note that JPMorgan Chase remains a major diversified banking exposure, while Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley provide greater sensitivity to investment banking, trading and institutional activity. BlackRock and Charles Schwab offer exposure to asset management and brokerage.

The expansion of data centers and industrial electrification is increasing attention on electricity generation and grid infrastructure. Nuclear power, transmission equipment and energy storage could become important long-term investment themes. However, the earnings forecasts show that rising structural demand does not automatically translate into immediate sector-wide profit growth.

Energy faces a difficult comparison after exceptionally strong projected earnings growth in 2026. Oil and gas prices, production levels and refining margins will remain notable drivers.

Utilities have a different investment profile. Rising electricity consumption could support long-term demand, but infrastructure expansion requires substantial capital and can expose companies to financing costs and regulatory constraints.

In a recent development, materials earnings are projected to increase 9.3% in 2027, compared with 31% in 2026. Revenue growth is expected to moderate from 7.7% to 4.4%.

Copper is an crucial investment theme because it is used in electricity transmission, data centers, manufacturing and electrification. Demand from infrastructure development could support mining companies, although supply additions, production costs and global industrial activity will influence prices.

Gold provides a different exposure. Central-bank purchases, geopolitical uncertainty and monetary conditions can influence demand, making gold producers relevant to investors seeking exposure to precious metals.

The Bloomberg consensus estimates reveal a clear gap between the leading and lagging sectors. Information Technology is projected to generate more than twice the earnings growth of the broader S&P 500, while Healthcare and Communication Services are expected to deliver the strongest improvement from their 2026 growth rates.

AI Capital Expenditure Could Outpace Revenue Growth.

Technology companies are committing substantial capital to AI infrastructure. If spending rises faster than monetization, depreciation and financing expenses could weaken margins. The market may increasingly reward companies demonstrating measurable AI revenue rather than those simply increasing infrastructure expenditure.

Higher Bond Yields Could Pressure Equity Valuations.

It has been revealed that interest rates remain central to the market outlook. Higher Treasury yields can increase corporate borrowing costs and reduce the present value of future earnings, particularly for companies whose valuations depend on long-term growth expectations.

Earnings Estimates Leave Less Room for Disappointment.

With S&P 500 earnings projected to grow 20.2% in 2027, companies face demanding expectations. A slowdown in revenue, weaker margins or disappointing corporate guidance could trigger valuation adjustments across sectors.

Recent findings suggest that the broader market’s ability to sustain its rally will depend on whether earnings growth spreads across more companies and industries. Investors will need to distinguish between structural demand and actual profitability, particularly in sectors requiring significant capital expenditure.

As 2027 approaches, the strongest investment opportunities could emerge from companies combining above-market earnings growth with sustainable revenue, improving margins and disciplined capital allocation.

The Healthiest Thing You Can Do for Your Prostate at Age 50

📅 19 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 4 min read (726 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Menshealth

⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Prostate cancer is the second leading cause of cancer deaths in men, so you’d think doctors would be adamant about screening guys for it.
  • Sources indicate that many guys didn’t know whether they should get it or not.
  • It has been revealed that the American Cancer Society just came out with latest guidelines that for the first time, unequivocally say that men should get the screening test.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Prostate cancer is the second leading cause of cancer deaths in men, so you’d think doctors would be adamant about screening guys for it. Yet for years, prostate cancer screening via the PSA (prostate-specific antigen) test has been plagued by vague recommendations, and some back-and-forth messaging that flipped between “get it” and “the benefits might not be worth it.” Until recently, organizations including the American Cancer Society (ACS) used to give a recommendation that at age 50, guys should talk with their doctors about screening, then engage in a process of “shared decision-making” about whether to get the test.

Sources indicate that many guys didn’t know whether they should get it or not. Without a clear recommendation, it was easy for some to think this PSA blood test wasn’t very notable to do at all. The landscape has changed.

It has been revealed that the American Cancer Society just came out with latest guidelines that for the first time, unequivocally say that men should get the screening test. Guys at average risk should start at age 50. Guys at higher risk (more on that later) should start at 45.

Recent findings suggest that why that’s a big deal: “The upcoming guideline not only gets rid of shared decision-making, which is really difficult to execute, is subject to bias, and is really time-intensive,” states Yaw Nyame, MD, of the Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center at the University of Washington Medical Center. “But it couples that with a better understanding of what present-day prostate cancer screening is.”.

Today, the PSA test is “just the first step, not the final answer,” notes William Dahut, MD, chief scientific officer at ACS, and a contributing author to the guidelines. “It is a simple blood test, and an elevated result does not automatically mean cancer of the need for a biopsy.” Many more tools including MRIs and biomarkers help physicians drill down on who needs additional testing. “Our goal is to find prostate cancer earlier, while avoiding unnecessary procedures and treatment,” Dr. Dahut adds.

Industry observers note that what changed that prompted the revised recommendations? “It’s key to understand that guidance evolves as the evidence does,” says Dr. Dahut. Research has piled up to indicate that PSA screening reduces prostate cancer deaths.

It has been revealed that “We do not need to make a disclaimer that maybe you should, maybe you shouldn’t do it. Everyone should do it and you should start early, especially if you have a higher risk of cancer,” indicates Dr. Nyame, who was on the expert panel that reviewed the upcoming ACS screening guidelines.

While all men should get the test, according to the latest guidelines, it’s not a “one size fits all” screening recommendation, Dr. Nyame explains. Recommendations vary according to risk. Find your category and screen according to that.

These are the new ACS guidelines for who and when:.

Other prostate screening guidelines came out earlier in 2026 from the American Urological Association (AUA) and the Society for Urologic Oncology (SUO) that had slightly different recommendations for the age at which you should start screening. What gives? The difference in recommended age and frequency of screening “has to do with how the guideline creators are viewing the different studies that they’re using to support their decision making,” Dr. Nyame indicates.

Recent findings suggest that it doesn’t mean guys should throw up their hands and do nothing in frustration. “The AUA/SUO and ACS guidelines recognize the benefit of knowing a PSA test result earlier in life. A PSA test in the 40- to 50-year age range is a good predictor of the likelihood someone has or will develop a clinically significant prostate cancer,” says James A. Eastham, MD, chief of the urology service, Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center. A higher level early in life is a strong signal that you need to be really diligent about checking your PSA.

Recent findings suggest that “We’ve watched prostate cancer incidence increase—especially metastatic cancer, for over a decade now,” indicates Dr. Nyame. “And to know that we have a guideline that is so action-oriented toward reversing that course is really exciting.”.

Sources indicate that marty Munson, right now the health director of Men's Health, has been a health editor at properties including Marie Claire, Prevention, Shape and RealAge. She's also certified as a swim and triathlon coach.

As demand for major crypto assets has increased, Ethereum remains on hold amid growing market fear and uncertainty, while exchange activities across the broad crypto market are showing a bearish trend.

While Ethereum remains one of the most affected cryptocurrencies during the prolonged crypto market volatility, the latest data from the crypto analytics platform CryptoQuant reveals a massive slowdown in its exchange outflows.

Amid growing market fear, Ethereum outflows from Binance over the last month have hit a historic low as investors continue to move fewer ETH tokens away from the world’s largest crypto exchange, Binance.

The data indicates that about 3.58 million ETH have been withdrawn from Binance over the last 30 days, marking an all-time low in Ethereum outflows on the exchange.

Further data indicates that the decline has come as Ethereum continues to struggle to stabilize its price and continues to weaken, trading around the $1,700 mark.

It is vital to note that the decline in exchange outflows is expected, considering the growing market weakness and negative shift in investor sentiment over the period.

However, the metric has drawn different attention from market participants, given expectations that the massive security breach Binance suffered should trigger large withdrawals from the exchange.

Although blockchain trackers recently identified multiple large Ethereum withdrawals by the Binance hacker, it appears that the moves did not materialize into increased Ethereum outflows.

Apart from the attackers' withdrawals, it appears that Ethereum holders on the exchange did not respond to the attack in the conventional way, as security incidents like this often make investors more cautious and wary about keeping their assets on the exchange.

While this typically prompts them to transfer the assets into private wallets where they have greater control, it appears that Ethereum holders remained comfortable with keeping their funds on the exchange.

The latest Ethereum liquidity data raises questions about whether a price rebound can attract enough buyers or may be simply bring another wave of selling.

The 30-day liquidity index on Binance has plunged from around 1.1 to 0.35 as ETH declined from roughly $2,750 to $1,700. Aside from the chart’s opening period in 2019, that’s its lowest reading.

According to recent reports, more concerning, the index has fallen below its 2022 lows while ETH remains above its 2022 price bottom. That disconnect makes the next recovery harder to interpret.

It has been revealed that A rebound in activity doesn’t automatically mean fresh buying. In 2022, liquidity recovered before ETH revisited its range lows. In late 2023, improving activity accompanied a more sustained advance.

It has been revealed that the exchange’s on-chain deposit data has also changed dramatically. Daily ETH deposits reportedly fell from around 2,800 in October to roughly 300 after withdrawals reopened in November.

Ethereum-based USDT deposits dropped from 16,000 to about 160 daily. Tron-based USDT deposits fell from roughly 100,000 to fewer than 30.

According to recent reports, yet BTC deposits remained comparatively steady, slipping from around 10,300 to 9,000. Meanwhile, daily stablecoin value still averages about $680 million, and average ETH deposits rose from 80 to 270 ETH.

The deposit collapse could reflect customers changing networks, fewer small transfers or Binance changing its deposit infrastructure.

Recent findings suggest that for now, Ethereum liquidity on Binance remains a warning sign, not a confirmed market-wide verdict. A higher low alongside recovering spot activity would offer stronger evidence of demand than rising transfer counts alone.

One rather unusual metric on XRP Ledger has seen more than a 3,062% increase in usage which raises a lot of questions. This is one of the largest spikes throughout the year in a function usage that mostly stays low.

The function allows people to manage their secondary keys for signing transactions on their wallets and/or accounts. Their main private keys stay offline, while a certain key issued by them is used in daily transactions.

It allows safer work and utilization of their wallets without potentially exposing their private keys. So even if someone grabs hold of your signing credentials, you'll be able to protect your funds by nullifying the issued keys, provided you still retain authorized access.

One way or another, the surge is bizarre. Most likely "legit" scenarios are: automated key rotations among large custodians like exchanges. Some security warnings that triggered massive migration and then, the illicit one: generation of function calls from bots or automated scripts.

The flatlined chart actually represents tens or hundreds of calls daily, but a surge to nearly 4,000 is certainly out of the blue. Unfortunately, we were unable to identify the source of those transactions.

Recent findings suggest that the feature itself is legitimate, so the spike alone does not indicate that users' funds or wallets are at risk. However, an undisclosed exploit or security problem cannot be ruled out without further investigation.

One concerning scenario would involve malicious actors gaining access to wallets and assigning fresh regular keys to maintain control over them. This would not necessarily mean that the XRP Ledger itself has been compromised, but rather that individual accounts may have been targeted.

For now, there is no evidence pointing toward such an attack, and the activity could just as easily be attributed to routine security operations.

Still, XRP holders should keep an eye on any unexpected changes to their account settings, especially regular keys they did not authorize.

According to recent reports, whether this was a coordinated security upgrade, automated activity, or something more concerning remains unclear. What is certain is that such an unusual spike deserves closer attention, particularly if similar activity continues over the coming days.

Long-time Shiba Inu community member and SHIB developer, Mazrael, has reacted to Solana-based memecoin platform Pump.fun's recent wallet login changes, which are sparking concerns about private key security.

In a fresh announcement, Pump.fun stated that external wallet sign-in is being retired on November 30, 2026. Starting November 30, 2026 (15:00 UTC), Pump.fun on the web will only allow customers to sign in with an email account or a Google, Apple, or GitHub account instead of an external wallet such as Phantom, Solflare, or Ledger.

Pump.fun reassures people that nothing will happen to their funds or account, as their wallet address, positions, callouts, followers and username remain unchanged. The only change is how users sign in.

Customers who sign in to their accounts with Phantom or any other wallet are urged to take action before the November 30, 2026 deadline.

Pump.fun outlined a number of steps for customers on how to switch their sign-in; of particular concern is the step that asked users to enter their wallet details and paste their private key when prompted. Pump.fun noted that this step encrypts the key in the user's browser and that the key is end-to-end encrypted by its login provider, Privy, allowing users' wallets to continue working for everything else.

Mazrael reacted to the development, drawing attention to the potential security implications for users.

It has been revealed that pumpfun is retiring external wallet logins on web starting Nov 30. From then on you sign in with Google, Apple, email or GitHub. To keep your existing account..... they want you to paste your private key into their Privy flow 😬 Also note their own terms claims they won’t ask for private keys...

The standard security practice across the cryptocurrency industry is that exchanges, wallet providers and other platforms do not ask customers to disclose their private keys or recovery phrases. Such warnings are routinely issued to protect users from unauthorized access to their funds.

The Pump.fun wallet login change process appears to contradict this widely promoted security principle, Mazrael noted.

Private keys are highly sensitive credentials that give holders direct access to their cryptocurrency wallets. Whoever gets their hands on them might be able to access those wallets and move the funds. In general, it is recommended never to share private keys with individuals, support agents or third-party services.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Bitcoin (BTC) could face another sharp decline before beginning its next major rally, with analysts warning that the cryptocurrency may still have more downside ahead despite already suffering a significant correction.

It has been revealed that meanwhile, analyst SeffafNet believes Bitcoin could fall as low as $49,000, identifying several support levels that could come into play if selling pressure continues. His outlook suggests that the market may experience one final capitulation before buyers return and trigger a broader recovery.

Bitcoin’s recent weakness has reinforced concerns about another leg down, with traders closely watching whether the token can hold its current support levels or extend its decline toward lower price targets.

According to the analyst, Bitcoin’s downside roadmap remains unchanged, with $58,000 serving as the first major level, followed by $55,000, $53,000, and potentially $49,000.

Notably, he views the $53,000 region as a potential final liquidity sweep, where additional selling could force leveraged investors and traders out of their positions before the market finds a more durable bottom.

If Bitcoin reaches $49,000, SeffafNet believes the move could mark the end of the current correction and create an opportunity for a major reversal. Nevertheless, he stressed that the price target is not guaranteed, describing it as a scenario he is preparing for rather than a certainty.

He believes investors could make costly decisions if they panic during another sell-off, particularly if the decline occurs near the end of the broader market correction.

Additionally, analyst Crypto Patel maintains a bearish outlook, suggesting Bitcoin could experience a temporary recovery before resuming its downward movement.

It has been revealed that the pundit identified a potential relief rally toward the $71,504-$74,800 region, where a bearish order block and fair value gap could provide resistance. Such a move could offer temporary relief to traders following the recent decline without necessarily signaling a broader trend reversal.

Crypto Patel said Bitcoin’s higher time-frame bearish structure remains intact, although a breakdown has not yet been confirmed. He is watching for a candle close below $57,800, which would strengthen the case for additional downside.

Furthermore, if that level breaks, his broader downside targets extend between $50,000 and $35,000, placing his outlook below SeffafNet’s $49,000 bottom projection.

However, Crypto Patel would reconsider his bearish position if Bitcoin records a higher-time frame candle close above $87,400, the level he identified as the critical change-of-character threshold.

Despite Bitcoin’s weakness, Michael Van de Poppe sees a potentially encouraging development in Ethereum’s performance against Bitcoin.

The analyst noted that Bitcoin fell approximately 25% over the two weeks, while Ethereum’s performance against BTC remained relatively stable. He considers this resilience a sign of strength, particularly because altcoins typically suffer greater losses against Bitcoin during severe market downturns.

At press time, BTC was trading at $61,292, up 0.85% over the past 24 hours.
